Class FinishedWorld

java.lang.Object
greenfoot.World
FinishedWorld
public class FinishedWorld extends greenfoot.World

This is the finished world which appears after the simulation. Depending on the results, there are different endings There are three endings in total:

  • Ending one: students having pizza party, if averageMark >= 85
  • Ending two: students walking around in the classroom while Mr.Cohen is sleepy, if 65>= averageMark <85
  • Ending three: students feel sad while Mr.Cohen is angry, if averageMark < 65

There are two buttons at the right hand side:

  • Main menu button(backToMenue), this can redirect the user to the titleScreen
  • Try again button(tryAgain), this can redirect the user to the Modifier

      Constructor for objects of class FinishedWorld.
      Parameters:
      int - averageMark: average mark of all students after the simulation is done
      int - numDays: number of days during the simulation
      int - studentIQ: average IQ of students during the simulation
      int - customerSupportChance: chance of customer support gets back to Mr.Cohen during the simulation
      int - computerBreakingChance: chance of Mr.Cohen's computer being damaged or stolen during the simulation
      boolean - hasRobber: whether or not the simulation contains robber
      boolean - hasJanitor: whether or not the simulation contains janitor
